item.title: GearUP Hyperev WLAN Site Survey utils.lua get wlan sitesurvey os command injection
item.description: A vulnerability was found in GearUP Hyperev up to 20261020. This impacts the function get wlan sitesurvey of the file ld/utils.lua of the component WLAN Site Survey. Performing a manipulation of the argument line results in os command injection. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

item.title: Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG) Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
item.description: Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG) contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to invoke a configuration-import function and restore a crafted, compatible backup archive, resulting in unauthorized modification of the appliance’s global configuration. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-111560.
